lineage.description: IOM DTM conducted repeated baseline assessment rounds (rounds 2–16) in South Sudan using field-based enumeration at village and settlement level, collecting counts of internally displaced persons (IDPs) and returnees disaggregated by arrival period and state/county of habitual residence. Data are aggregated to payam and county administrative units and published as tabular datasets with geographic coordinates for each assessed location.

sources.name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)
sources.description: DTM baseline assessments collect displacement data through field enumeration and key informant interviews at settlement level, quantifying IDP and returnee populations across South Sudan using the DTM Methodological Framework for Quantifying Displacement and Mobility.

resources.title: DTM South Sudan Baseline Assessment Round 16
resources.description: This report presents findings from Round 16 of the Mobility Tracking exercise, conducted by the International Organization for Migration's (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) across South Sudan, through key-informant assessments at location-level between December 2024 and February 2025. Mobility Tracking estimates the presence of internally displaced persons (IDPs) and returnees in South Sudan in displacement sites and host communities. IOM DTM mapped a total of 1,992,513 IDPs, of whom 13 per cent were previously abroad, and 2,963,408 returnees, including 38 per cent returnees from abroad, in 4,074 locations across the 10 States in South Sudan.

resources.title: DTM South Sudan Baseline Assessment Round 13
resources.description: The round 13 of Mobility Tracking conducted across South Sudan through key-informant assessments at location-level in August 2022. Mobility Tracking estimates the presence of internally displaced persons (IDPs) and returnees in South Sudan in displacement sites and host communities. IOM DTM mapped a total of 2,257,672 IDPs, of whom 7% were previously displaced abroad, and 2,175,352 returnees, of whom 29% returned from abroad, in 3,614 locations across South Sudan as of August 2022.

resources.title: DTM South Sudan Baseline Assessment Round 2
resources.description: In this second round, the IOM DTM covered a total of 225 payams in 46 counties located across 8 states. This report specifically focuses on returnees and IDP population in Kapoeta South County, where data collection covered 17 bomas in 5 payams, from April - June, 2018. Mobility tracking captured a total of 2,884 IDPs (866 households) and 589 returnees (154 households). Additionally, 266 individuals (52 households) were documented as having relocated to teh area, and the host community is estimated to include 32,130 persons (9,257 households).
